Who is she really, and why can't he get her out of his head? Does she even exist, and do we really want to know the answer to that question?

The protagonist, suffering from Paranoid Schizophrenia, will have to make a difficult decision – whether to stay at home without medication and uncover the dark secret of his neighbor? Or should he buy the medicine and go to meet his missing sister, who, for the first time in ten years, has given a sign of life?

Depending on the choices made, the player will either lock themselves in their apartment with their own demons or venture into the city, discovering an alternative course of events. The game can be completed in two ways, showing how the simple decision to stay or leave the apartment profoundly affects the protagonist's fate.

notes.title: Agony missing from the libraries - What's next? [UPDATED]
notes.notes:
[b]UPDATE:[/b] 
Hello guys, as you can see, we've set up several separate bundles for different regions, depending on the minimum price that each region allowed us to get away with. It ranges from 65 to 95% off. 

It's worth mentioning that this is a temporary solution and the only one available to us using our tools. We are, however, contacting Steam and GOG as well to ask for a significant number of free keys for Agony UNRATED (for those who are unaware, devs can't generate a big number of keys without giving the platform owner a good reason to do so).

If they provide us with those, we'll set up a system where Agony owners will be able to claim their lost copy of the game. Stay tuned here or on our Discord to get an update on that.

[b]ORIGINAL TEXT:[/b]

Dear players,

Over the past weekend, we received numerous inquiries from you and requests to explain why suddenly, 3 years after the game's premiere, Agony UNRATED was separated from Agony.

[b]Reminder[/b]: So far, every player who bought regular Agony on Steam automatically found Agony UNRATED in their library as well. 

At the launch of Agony UNRATED [b]in 2018, we entered into an agreement with Steam[/b] whereby the combination of the two games was implemented. Due to the fact that we couldn’t - technically - connect both applications, the Steam crew made the connection. 

However, last week [b]Steam decided that the 2018 arrangement has to be changed[/b] and the two applications need to be separated. The reason that led to this situation is probably (that's our guess) because some players who intentionally bought the game in the censored version also got access to the uncensored version, which they did not want. (There is also a different age rating for both games).

Accordingly, the two games can no longer be linked together and we were asked to remove any posts & announcements that linked to adult-only versions of our games, which you might’ve noticed as some of the pinned threads have disappeared. We had no choice in the matter as not complying with Steam’s demands could lead to a removal of all our games from the platform. 

Using the tools available to us, we tried to find a solution that would be the best for you - players - in this situation. Therefore, we’ll create a [b]special Bundle[/b] in which every Agony owner has a [b]95+% discount on Agony UNRATED[/b] (which is the lowest value you can discount that game by) so that the "upgrade" to the unrated version will cost as little as possible. This is the best solution we can think of that’s within our reach, though we’re still in talks with Steam, trying to find another way to resolve this issue.

We are very sorry for this whole situation. Despite the fact that it did not result directly from our fault, it affects the game we created and we feel responsible for everything concerning it. As a developer, we learn from mistakes. The situation with Agony UNRATED was something new for us and we are glad that Steam allowed us to develop a solution that was beneficial for you at that time. [b]We made sure that similar problems won’t show up in the future[/b] as all of the adult-only versions of our latest games are DLCs instead of being separate apps on the platform.

It is also worth noting that this situation only applies to players who got Agony UNRATED as a bonus when purchasing Agony. These players have lost access to Agony UNRATED. Players who purchased Agony UNRATED separately are not affected. These players still have full access to the game.

You can contact us via

info@madmind-studio.com

[b]Madmind Studio[/b]

notes.title: AGONY: Lords of Hell
notes.notes:
[b]Dear Martyrs,[/b]

[b]AGONY: Lords of Hell[/b] is a new title from the World of Agony, for which the newly created internal team of Madmind Studio - Team Alpha is responsible. The team's task, apart from producing the new game, will also be supporting Succubus in the form of free updates and paid DLC in 2022.

Agony and Agony UNRATED have already reached almost 800,000 players around the world. The players’ appreciation prompted us to release Succubus, a game that was set in the Agony universe, continuing and developing some of the plot and lore. Agony: Lords of Hell [b]shows the events that took place between Agony and Succubus[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25386726/8d24d7b67f23532297322dfef89f9d9efb39bdd1.jpg[/img]

The story of the game will tell about the fate of the main characters of Agony and Succubus - king Nimrod and Vydija, a demonic succubus. With the departure of the rightful rulers of Hell, [b]a war for the throne broke out[/b]. The lords of hell, ruling over different lands, begin to gather armies of demons to slay the rulers who threatened them. Our heroes will be forced not only to maintain their current position, but also to expand their empire and conquer the enemy territories.

The main inspiration for the gameplay in Agony: Lords of Hell is the iconic Populous series. While the main character of the game - Nimrod, will focus on developing the city and managing the army, the demonic Vydijia will become the main unit controlled by the player. With numerous combat skills and special powers, Vydija will lead Nimrod's army to victory, and will be the key strategic element of every battle. Thanks to her high position among other succubi, Vydija will use her abilities to seduce and then incorporate martyrs, who do not belong to any of the factions, into her own army.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25386726/f04f463a66365acc5ded0b7418eff49179f646f8.jpg[/img]

Similar to Agony, we want players to be able to decide about the scale of Agony: Lords of Hell project. In 2022, players from around the world will be able to support this ambitious project using the Kickstarter crowdfunding platform. During the planned crowdfundning, players will decide how extensive Agony: Lords of Hell will be. A demo version of the game will be available to players supporting the game, which will allow them to get to know its unique world, full of dangers, horrors and ... Strategy!

The first trailer of the game will be presented [b]on December 16, 2021, during MADNIGHT 2021: Horror Showcase[/b].

[b]Cheers,[/b]
Madmind Studio

Later this year, players will be able to watch and test the first gameplay from our new game!

[h1]Cherub in Agony UNRATED[/h1]

Today, we published [b]a free update to the Agony UNRATED available on Steam.[/b] After downloading the new content, players will be able to come across a new demon species - [b]Cherub[/b] - in many places during the game. Although in [b]SUCCUBUS[/b] he will act as the opponent, players can now take a closer look at this demon, finding him in the [b]story mode of [/b][b]Agony UNRATED[/b]! At the same time, we would like to point out that we do not rule out enriching the content of our already released games with further free updates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33775390/4c13e66f2039505bb339193f0e36fb80fce07883.png[/img]

[h1]Cherub Characteristic[/h1]

Cherub is a demon who, like the iconic Onoskelis, can wield fire. Using pyrokinesis, he tries to keep the right distance from the player to minimize the risk of direct contact, which usually ends fast and brutal.
Cherub is not a character who prefers an honorable duel, which is why he usually appears in numerous groups, trying to encircle his victim.

[h1]Lore[/h1]

Cherub is a type of demon that was born of sin, while various species of infernal creatures began to interbreed with each other. The deformed body of this creature often moves in contradictory logic, giving the impression that each of the two demons joined together lives according to their own rules. His survival often depends on more powerful demons who live in correlation with him, benefiting from each other. When the characteristic scream of Onoskelis resounds in hell, it is the Cherub who is the first to arrive, helping in the fight and hoping for the possibility of eating warm corpses.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33775390/76f44f1a2601ef68a66652b69a1768a62f07ea1a.jpg[/img]
 
[h1]Gameplay[/h1]

This type of demon usually attacks his victims when outnumbering them. He tries to circle the character and set it on fire with long-range fireballs. He often responds to the call of more powerful beings, arriving at the indicated place and supporting a larger demon in the fight. Only by killing the demon that summons Cherubs, you can stop the next ones from incoming.
Solo Cherub is an easy-to-kill character, so he tries to engage in combat only when the player is in a duel with stronger opponents.
 
[h1]Tactics[/h1]
 
- Start the elimination with a demon that summons Cherubs
- Always be on the move and use dodges to bypass ranged attacks quickly
- Use environmental traps to hurt many Cherubs at once
- Deflect attacks by pairing them at the right time
- Use magic and long-range attacks
- Use alternative weapon attacks and nail cherubs to walls and ceilings

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33775390/222553dda388d7224bd77db6a12bec3d7288367d.jpg[/img]

[b]Have fun,[/b]

notes.title: Agony UNRATED console version - official statement!
notes.notes:
[b]Dear Console Players, [/b]

We are aware that you are disappointed because you cannot play [b]Agony UNRATED[/b] but, like we stated before, it is not possible to publish the digital uncensored version of our game on consoles.

You have also asked about the improvements that are a big part of [b]Agony UNRATED[/b]. Replacing 3D models and textures, adding new functionalities and gameplay mechanics and adding new lighting, would require re-certification and the game would have to be re-sent to rating agencies. 

[b]Creating UNRATED as a DLC is not possible.[/b]

We cannot even do it on [b]Steam[/b] because it would mean disregarding rating agencies and changing the target group, which is illegal due to the fact that the owners of the basic Agony version have paid for the censored version and we simply cannot change the rating.

Therefore, the release of Agony UNRATED is possible only as a separate application, unrelated to age ratings.

[b]The only possibility for Agony UNRATED to appear on consoles is to publish it as a physical version.[/b]

Few stores would decide to distribute such a game, therefore finding a publisher who would be interested in producing [b]UNRATED[/b] for consoles is extremely complicated.

In order for us to have a chance to do so, we need to have a basis that will show the potential publisher that his investment will return and allow him to earn.

Let’s keep our fingers crossed for the [b]positive reception of Agony UNRATED[/b] on Steam because the probability of the console version depends on its success.

[b]A lot of us at Madmind own both Xbox One and PS4[/b] and we would really love to have [b]Agony UNRATED[/b] for consoles in our collection.  [b]Therefore nothing is sealed yet and we will inform you if we know anything more.[/b]

[h1]Legal statement[/h1] 
Unfortunately, but the contracts we have in force, both publishing and rating, blocked us from releasing the patch and removing the censorship from the game. Any lawsuit related to the violation of these rules would most likely lead to the closure of our studio.
 
To release Agony Unrated, we had to choose an alternative route and remain in the shadows by announcing the suspension of our work on the game. Today, after a few months since the release of Agony, the deadline for contracts binding us has passed and we can share these details with you.
 
At the moment, the PC is the only platform that gives us the freedom to create the world we've come up with. This, unfortunately, means Agony Unrated can never appear as a Digital Edition on consoles.
If players and reviewers positively receive Agony Unrated, we will try to get a contract with the publisher who will agree to issue a limited number of copies of the boxed game, both on PS4 and Xbox One.

Haunted by nightmare creatures, players gain the ability to possess demons and other souls to find their way out of hell.
 
[h1]About Madmind Studio[/h1]
Madmind Studio is a game development studio created in 2016 by Tomasz Dutkiewicz. We are the team of game developers who are working for more than ten years in the video gaming industry. Our studio comprises veteran game developers, who have worked on numerous AAA titles, such as Witcher 3, The Division, Sniper: GW2, Alien Rage, Enemy front and more. The invaluable experience we have gained with these titles allows us to use this knowledge not only to translate it into high-quality titles but also to help and train new, passionate people who are just beginning their adventure with the gaming industry. At first, our studio only had nine people. The dynamic development of the company has allowed us to increase the number of employees. Currently, we have 23 employees employed.
